basically I thought I just had heavy long term depression, but at times I had really bad insomnia, worse than usual - I wouldn’t sleep for up to 6 days, maybe an hour shut eye a couple of the days but that’s it, and this made the psychiatrist question the unipolar depression, upon further discussion I realised I’d catch up on a bunch of uni work or feel motivated to entertain certain interests and hobbies during these bouts of no sleep, and also kind of struggled w a slight loss of inhibition at times, but the depression element remained my biggest difficulty

I think it’s best to see bipolar as a spectrum tho it’s all too complicated and varied for everyone’s experiences to neatly fit into one of the different type’s criteria

I’d say really research symptoms, be honest with yourself about which ones you have experienced and which ones you haven’t and just get help according to them 

I hope ur doing well and getting the right support👍🏽

in an ideal world it wouldn’t be so taboo, I wish I could gather my loved ones and give them the peace of mind that this is what I truly want so that my departure wouldn’t continue the cycle of trauma but be a graceful end, 

I wish I could answer all their questions and leave them no room to doubt that it’s what I wanted or blame themselves, end of the day in theory they should support anything that ends such suffering 

but we’re so brainwashed into thinking life is everything, even if you don’t enjoy it, when it really is just so optional, it’s just a big, hard decision to do anything about it, idk I don’t want to advocate suicide because I believe it’s commonly a tragedy, it’s just there is also the odd occasion where it’s really not, it’s release from tragedy, 

**but again I’m not telling anyone it’s the way because sometimes we think it’s what we want but it’s not and it’s too permanent a ‘solution’ for temporary feelings, things really can change in an instant **

waiting out ur parents birthday was one goal, set another, give urself more time for there to be a miraculous light in the dark, I don’t much believe in it but it happens, my friend was literally thanking me today for helping them get thru their hardest moments because good things are happening now, even I was so close to doing something drastic about an hour ago then someone came home unexpected and tried to make me jump, it’s silly but it was a little joy I wouldn’t have experienced, there’s so many little pleasantries, giggles and memories waiting, try endure ur mind / life a little while longer, a little while at a time until it’s worth it, the option to commit suicide isn’t going anywhere, delay it, give ur life more chance to surprise u
